purpose: Shared two-generation DR packet-mode successor. Preserve the frozen Earnings-21 discovery roster, fixed 90-second source windows, original draft-refresh instruction and model-visible frame. The two generation parents are the constrained unit-draft arm and constrained self-draft twin; free delivery remains a zero-contact derivative for each parent. Formal packet transport replaces raw-audio dispatch only after a complete current-build source-bound promotion is pinned.
policy_override_contract: The successor binds obs-repair-loop-ojw through dedicated OJW packet baseline derivatives. They preserve the inherited prompts, repair frames, predecessor bindings, and delivery rules; the only request transport change is the declared formal input_speech_features packet binding. No launcher, raw-cache fallback, or hidden runtime switch is used.

population.selection: no draw: the whole frozen earnings21-original discovery split -- the same 44 calls, the same 1,593 fixed 90-second windows and the same split identity the sealed comparator, KC-E1, KC-E1f and OBS-E1 all flew. The E5 split (34 kb-construction, 10 r4-e21-sub10 evaluation) is a REPORTING split; the ten carry 342 paired windows, below the program's n >= 400 rule, and are reported apart and descriptively with no interval quoted.
population.estimand: corpus WER and per-entity-class ConEC-mirror entity WER, pooled over the reported roster, paired at the 90-second window and clustered at the call against the sealed comparator, against OBS-E1 and against KC-E1f.

unit_draft.why_it_is_not_reflown: OBS-E1 already decoded every one of these units, and its bytes ARE the draft. Re-flying pass 1 would double the contacts, spend a second 1.07 GPU-h, and -- because greedy decoding on llama-server is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions -- would produce a draft that is NOT the arm the family is read against.

self_draft.why_it_is_the_twin: the DR-1s draft is the comparator's own sealed hypothesis for the same window: a long-window draft refreshed with the same long window. It isolates the draft's SOURCE, which is the only thing DR-1c claims.

secondary_comparators.SAEA-E21-OBS-E1-SPEAKER-TURN-UNITS-V1: corpus WER 7.15078, PERSON 24.58005. Does the refresh recover the names the units lost? REJECTED under its own rule and quoted as a comparator, never as an admitted effect.
secondary_comparators.SAEA-E21-KC-E1F-REPAIR-44-V1: Historical repair comparator; its scientific replication is complete. Full historical constrained delivery parity is verified for 1,593 windows and 44 stitched calls. Current shared-executor live bridge evidence remains pending.

comparator.pairing_rule: the fixed 90-second window is the paired unit (1,593), the call is the bootstrap cluster (44), the estimator is the pooled ratio through analysis.paired.resampled_statistic with cluster_of=analysis.e21_window_pairing.call_of, seed 20260903, 10,000 replicates, CI90, both weightings.

shared_protocol.prompt_order: speech-query-prefix-v2 (from q4km-e21-dr-full-packets-cddb000c-np6). The sealed draft remains rendered in the inherited task instruction and frame; the source-bound formal packet replaces raw input_audio only at transport dispatch.
shared_protocol.payload_fields: The packet baseline's declared speech-feature identity fields and the matched source-bound input_speech_features packet are carried through the shared OJW window query path. evidence_source remains none; no external knowledge or raw-audio fallback is enabled.
shared_protocol.contacts_per_item: ONE per 90-second window; 1,593 windows over 44 calls per cell. Pass 1 is read, not flown.
shared_protocol.harness: The common four-fragment factory builds FlightRuntime with the Earnings runtime adapter. The registered obs-repair-loop-ojw policy uses the shared OpenJiuwen executor and existing repair hooks. Explicit obs_controller_program=phase-direct-only-v1 routes each window through EvidenceAgentController while preserving the original model-visible instruction and delegate delivery. This is a single-phase compatibility bridge; live multi-stage performance remains unproven.

family_execution_plan.meaning: Two generation groups only: constrained unit-draft and constrained self-draft. The 1,750-call value is a per-generation ceiling with retry headroom; it does not authorize extra probes, adaptive repeats, or a third group.

fit_execution_plan.basis: One GET /props plus, per exact window request, one /apply-template and two /tokenize calls around the single media marker. Exact speech chunk token counts come from the hash-validated packet. The cddb000c input_tokens route ignores formal descriptors and is not used for packet capacity.
